_doc: Pre-staged promptfoo red-team fallback summary used by scripts/pr-quality.ps1 when neither GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is available nor a real artifacts/evals/latest-run.json was generated locally. release-strict-final.yml and railway-deploy-api.yml MUST run a real promptfoo eval and overwrite this fallback by writing artifacts/evals/latest-run.json before invoking release-readiness.ps1; only the PR-quality lane uses this fixture so the gate stays deterministic for environments without a secret. The fixture passes Assert-PromptfooRedTeamSummary (dryRun=false; suite id=red-team passed=true exitCode=0); it does NOT contain real model outputs.
